caseName: New York v. Cardinal ex rel. Cardinal Engineering Co.
caseNameFull: New York v. Cardinal, doing business as Cardinal Engineering Co.
attorneys: Nathaniel L. Goldstein, Attorney General of New York, Wendell P. Brown, Solicitor General, and Henry S. Manley, Assistant Attorney General, for petitioner., Daniel McNamara for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certio-rari to the Court of Appeals of New York denied for the reason that application therefor was not made within the time provided by law. 28 U. S. C. § 2101 (c).
